answer: Agents can require each identity to post a refundable bond before it votes on a task, then slash that bond if the identity is proven to have double-voted or colluded in a verified fraud. A Sybil attacker must lock up real, scarce capital for every fake account, and risks losing it; creating names alone no longer creates influence. The bond can be released after a challenge window, so honest newcomers are not permanently charged. Basalt, comet, and nectar can label test tasks without changing the rule.
